headline: THREE MONTHS
FROM
COLLAPSE.

scenes.say: Good salary. Nice house. Three months without a paycheck and it all collapses.
Every raise brought a bigger mortgage, a better car, another monthly payment.
Fixed costs are the most dangerous kind. They don't shrink when your income does.
So you can't quit, can't take a risk, can't say no. You depend on the paycheck more than ever.
The middle class isn't stuck because they earn too little. Every dollar is spoken for before it arrives.
Keep fixed costs below your worst year's income, not your best.

takeaway: Keep fixed costs below your worst year's income, not your best.
